titles.title: National Housing Emergency Act of 2026
National Housing Emergency Act of 2026
To require the President to declare a national housing emergency and invoke the Defense Production Act to incentivize residential housing production, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the Committee on Financial Services, and in addition to the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
